title: Assistant Manager - Supply Chain Management

Job Description

 Participate in various stages of supply chain processes, in area of procurement/vendor management/logistics/ inventory/quality management to ensure service availability to the customers and at the same time driving cost efficiencies, quality management and timely delivery of orders. This is an operational role which is responsible for delivering results that have direct impact on the achievement of results for projects undertaken as per business requirements.

Responsibilities

 He / She would be responsible for service procurement for Network IT Procurement, Fiber, Infra, Mobility, Enterprise OM Up-scope and driving various sourcing initiatives to deliver targeted benefits to the business. He / She would be responsible for managing end-to-end procurement negotiations, order processing and maintaining the supply of required services. He / She will be responsible for Customer Vendor contract negotiation. He / She will be responsible for Billing Invoicing. He/ She would need to engage with internal user teams to understand of new projects / operations requirements and deals. He/ She would need to plan, manage, and maintain strategic vendor relationships and conduct negotiations of major procurement deals. He/ She would need to achieve the required level of category performance objectives (aligned with overall SCM objectives) set by the Category Lead - Services and also ensure that daily operations are at par with practices prevailing in the market. He/ She would need to assess supply and commercial risks and develop mitigation strategies. He/ She is responsible for adherence to Annual Procurement Plan, achieving objectives of savings and business velocity. Review procurement volumes by vendor product class/type, thereby, identify areas for Rate Contracts/Frame Contracts, finalize the same.

 Collaborate with key persons including demand delivery manager to ensure clarity of specifications SLAs.

 Review logistics to make sure they run smoothly.

Minimum qualification experience

Experience in supply chain managementrole. 7 - 9 years of procurement experience, preferably from a recognized organization(s) in Telecom, IT, Network or Service industry. Demonstrated history of applying sourcing levers to deliver cost savings to the organization in areas related to Services, IT,Networks, Corporate Services, Transportation, Managed Services, Passive Infra projects, IT Security Management, AMC, Office interior fit- projects, etc. Organizational effectiveness, project and change management Knowledge of supply chain regulation and compliances Strong skills in Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint and in finance (ERP) systems, preferably SAP Experience on working with e-Sourcing platforms Experience in developing category strategies, and executing strategic sourcing exercises Certifications like CIPS / CPSM

title: Product Innovation and Design Manager
description:
Department: Product & Design 
 Industry: Information & Technology, preferably Logistics & Freight 
 Location: Pune / Remote 
 Experience Range: 6+ years of combined Product Management and UX/Design experience; at least 3 years hands-on in Figma and design prototyping; 2+ years Product Management or managing product design team 
 Basic Qualification: BE/B-TECH/MCA/BCA or bachelor's degree in a related subject; formal design qualification (HCI, Interaction Design, Visual Design) strongly preferred 
 Travel Requirements: No 
 Website: www.quloi.com 
 Our mission Our mission is to Quantifying all activities for logistics stakeholders. 
 Our Vision Our vision is to Enable businesses to make the best logistics decisions. 
 Whats the Role? We are looking for a Product Innovation and Design Manager who is equally at home defining a new product concept and opening Figma to prototype it themselves. This is a senior role that combines: the strategic product thinking to identify and incubate new solutions, the hands-on design craft to bring those concepts to life using Figma and AI-powered prototyping tools such as Claude Design, and the management experience to lead and grow Qulois UX team. You will own the full arc from discovery to validated prototype — running user research, shaping product direction, designing and iterating in Figma, and leveraging Claude Design to accelerate high-fidelity prototyping before a single line of production code is written. Once a new module or solution is validated, you need to follow the Product basics and prepare the BRD, PRD and make sure the solution is documented properly. 
 Responsibilities/ Duties 1. Lead New Feature Discovery and Incubation: Identify opportunities for entirely new product modules/features by monitoring industry trends, competitor products, regulatory developments, and evolving logistics standards. Define proof-of-concept criteria and validate new concepts with pilot customers before committing engineering resources to full development. Maintain an innovation backlog — a prioritised pipeline of ideas at different validation stages — reviewed regularly with the Head of Product and leadership. Own the structured Product process from validated new modules to ensuring design assets, and product requirements are fully documented. 2. Design and Prototype Hands-On in Figma and Claude Design: Create wireframes, interaction flows, and high-fidelity UI designs directly in Figma for all new product initiatives and innovation concepts. Use Claude Design to rapidly generate and iterate on prototypes, accelerating the design-to-validation cycle and exploring a broader solution space before committing to a direction. Build and maintain a shared Figma component library and design system that all product surfaces — core and local versions — draw from, ensuring visual and interaction consistency across the platform. Produce handoff-ready design specifications, annotated prototypes, and developer notes that engineering teams can implement without ambiguity. 3. Lead and Develop the UX Team: Manage and mentor the UX team (UX researchers, interaction designers, UI designers), setting clear goals, development plans, and quality standards. Own the UX team roadmap and ensure design capacity is allocated across innovation initiatives, core product enhancements, and local version requirements — coordinated through the AI PM Orchestrator. Conduct structured design reviews and hold a consistently high bar for usability, accessibility, and visual quality across all Quloi product surfaces. Actively develop team members’ skills in AI-assisted design tooling, including Claude Design, as part of the team’s ongoing capability uplift. 4. Drive UX Research for New Solutions: Plan and lead UX research activities (user interviews, usability testing, journey mapping, contextual inquiry) to validate new module concepts at every stage. Synthesise research findings into clear product requirements, design briefs, and prioritised problem statements that both the UX team and engineering can act on. Ensure user insight drives every design decision — from initial concept sketch to final prototype — rather than being a one-time input at the start of discovery. 5. Collaborate Across the PM Organisation: Work with the VP of Product to ensure new modules are architecturally and visually compatible with the existing platform — building on the existing product database rather than rebuilding from scratch. Brief Local Version PMs on new modules entering the pipeline early enough for regional design requirements to be incorporated in the initial Figma files. Participate in cross-PM syncs and AI PM Orchestrator-led workflows covering documentation, Confluence pages, and Jira ticket hygiene. 6. Measure Innovation and Design Impact: Define success metrics at the proof-of-concept stage for each new module (e.g., pilot adoption rate, task completion in usability tests, stakeholder confidence score, prototype-to-build time saved via Claude Design). Track UX team performance including design delivery cycle time, usability test scores, design system adoption rate, and cross-team satisfaction. Report innovation pipeline status, prototype velocity, and UX team throughput to leadership on a regular cadence. 
 Criteria for the Role! Experience: 6+ years of combined Product Management and UX/Design experience. Candidates with only a PM background and no hands-on design craft, or only a design background with no PM experience, will not be considered. Figma Proficiency: Advanced Figma skills are non-negotiable — you must be able to independently produce wireframes, high-fidelity UI designs, interactive prototypes, and a structured component library to a professional standard. Claude Design Experience: Demonstrated experience using Claude Design or equivalent AI-powered prototyping tools to generate, iterate on, and validate product concepts. Ability to brief, prompt, and critically evaluate AI-generated design output. UX Team Management: Minimum 2 years of formal people management responsibility for a UX or product design team, including goal-setting, performance development, and capacity planning. 0-to-1 Product Experience: Proven track record of taking a new product concept from initial idea to validated proof-of-concept in a B2B SaaS environment. Portfolio evidence is required. UX Research Fluency: Hands-on experience planning and conducting user research (not just commissioning it). You know when to run a usability test versus a user interview, and can do both yourself when needed. Design Systems: Experience building and governing a shared component library or design system used by multiple teams or product surfaces. Industry Domain knowledge is a strong advantage: Strong interest in logistics, supply chain, or trade technology; able to understand an industry standard or regulatory document and translate it into a product and design implication. Platform Awareness: Understands multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture at a conceptual level; designs with component reuse, localisation, and scalability in mind from the first wireframe. Communication: Able to present early-stage, ambiguous concepts confidently to senior stakeholders and translate feedback into actionable design and product decisions. Tooling: Figma (advanced), Claude Design, Jira, Confluence. Familiarity with handoff tools (Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin) and user testing platforms (Maze, UserTesting, Lookback) is an advantage.

Key Skills: Ui/Ux,JIRA,Figma,Project Management,Rice,Product Strategy,Sprint Planning,Product Roadmap

description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title Configuration Engineer You are a part of A high-impact, global organization within Philips that works across all modalities - The Sustaining Engineering Team (STET). STET has been established as an entrepreneurial organization that focuses on fast-paced, high-quality portfolio transfers within the Philips global supply base to mitigate risk maximize profitability. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Create, release, and maintain SKU BOMs for finished goods, inclusive of packaging, manuals/IFUs, and accessories. Build and manage product configurations / variants / options / effectivities within PLM (Windchill preferred) and ensure synchronization with ERP. Ensure Configuration Management (CM) processes enable creation of complete, consistent Device History File (DHF) and Device Master Record (DMR) by downstream stakeholders. Drive and execute Change Management (e.g., ECR/ECN) ensuring controlled, auditable updates to product data. Lead Service BOM creation and alignment with EBOM/MBOM structures for serviceability and field support. Own master data quality across Part Management, Document Management, BOM Management, PDM Link , and related PLM objects. Collaborate with Project Management, RD, Manufacturing/Operations, Quality/Regulatory, and Supply Chain to define and implement configuration baselines and release plans. Monitor and improve data governance, naming/numbering conventions, and metadata completeness to support analytics and traceability. Support audits and CAPAs related to product data, configuration integrity, and document control. 
 
 Job Knowledge, Skills Experience 
 Bachelor s degree in mechanical, Industrial, Manufacturing engineering or a closely related technical field (required) 3-6 years in PLM/Configuration Management with Windchill/SAP exposure. Strong, hands-on knowledge of PLM (Windchill highly preferred) and PDM Link . Proven experience in product configuration creation and configuration management for complex products. Working knowledge of ERP and PLM-ERP integration concepts (materials, routings, effectivity, source lists). Demonstrated expertise in Change Management, Part Management, BOM Management, and Document Management . Experience creating Service BOMs and aligning them to EBOM/MBOM. Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders (PM, Engineering, Quality, Operations, Service, and Supply Chain). Certifications (nice to have): CM2/CMII , PTC Windchill certifications, 
 
 Personal Attributes 
 Flexible, yet accurate and consistent on content quality and data integrity. Strong communicator; capable of transferring knowledge and enforcing standards. Clear affinity with product development and lifecycle processes. Team player with the willingness and ability to lead when needed. Strong planning skills with the ability to prioritize own work. Fluent English communication skills-verbal and written Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams across multiple time zones. 
 
 How we work together 
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company's facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company's main facilities, generally at the customers or suppliers locations.

Job Title: Service Operations - Production Support Engineer Corporate Title: Associate Location: Pune, India

 At the heart of Deutsche Banks client franchise, is the Corporate Bank (CB), a market leader in Cash Management, Trade Finance Lending, Securities Services and Trust Agency services. Focusing on the Treasurers and Finance Departments of Corporate and Commercial clients and Financial Institutions across the Globe, our Universal Expertise and Global Network allow us to offer truly integrated and effective solutions.  Be technically hands-on with the resolution of technical functional incidents; user request tickets; troubleshooting of application, infrastructure and functional issues in the production environment. Act as a Production Engineering role model to enhance SRE capabilities of the Production Support teams to with engineering culture. Service Operations experience within a global operations context (ITIL Certification preferred). Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

description:

 A Senior Hardware Engineer and future leader who designs embedded product hardware end to end: architecture, power, analog, digital, microcontroller and communication interfaces - and then proves it on the bench. You will take products from requirements to a validated board, working alongside firmware, QA and manufacturing, across medical, industrial and IoT products. The person we are looking for owns the whole board, not just the schematic: they select components with supply and cost in mind, design for the enclosure and the test jig, and treat bring-up as part of design, not someone else s problem. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Architecture and Design 
 Work with the development team and product managers to define product hardware architecture. Design embedded product hardware as per requirements: power supply, analog, digital, microcontroller and communication interface sections. Select components balancing performance, availability, cost and lifecycle. Design and develop schematics in Altium Designer. 
 
 Layout and Manufacturing Hand-off 
 Design PCB layouts in Altium considering EMI/EMC and enclosure requirements, or guide a layout engineer doing so. Generate Gerber files and coordinate with PCB manufacturers on ordering, queries and delivery. Handle component procurement for prototypes and coordinate with the prototype assembly team. 
 
 Bring-up, Debug and Collaboration 
 Lead board bring-up, debugging and problem solving on your designs. Coordinate with the firmware team on hardware-firmware integration and with QA on validation. Mentor junior hardware engineers and review their schematics and layouts. 
 
 Technical Skills Required 
 Hardware Design: 5 to 7 years designing embedded product hardware: discrete, power and microcontroller-based designs. Power Analog: Power supply design (DC-DC, LDO), analog signal conditioning, protection circuits. Altium Designer: Schematic and PCB design; multilayer and mixed-signal boards. Memory Interfaces: Flash, eMMC, SDRAM, DDR2/3/4 design and integration. Interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART on-board; USB, Ethernet external interfaces. Wireless: BLE, Wi-Fi, RF, LoRa integration experience. Bring-up Debug: Board bring-up, systematic fault isolation, bench instruments (oscilloscope, logic analyser, multimeter). Collaboration: Strong communication; comfortable in a fast-paced Agile / Scrum environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills (Added Advantage) 
 Experience on medical devices or other regulated products (CE, FCC, UL, BIS, ISO 13485 awareness). EMI/EMC pre-compliance testing exposure and design-for-compliance practices. Working knowledge of embedded C to aid hardware-firmware debugging. Experience in a product design services or contract development environment. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Engineering graduate in an Electronics-based branch. 5 to 7 years of experience in embedded hardware design. Good verbal and written communication in English. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Your boards go from schematic review to validated bring-up with few surprises. Firmware engineers trust your designs and your judgement during integration debugging. Junior engineers improve measurably from your reviews and mentoring.

title: Hardware Electronic Design Engineer (M.Tech)
description:
Hardware Electronic Design Engineer (M.Tech) Location: Viman Nagar, Pune Department: Electronics / Hardware Design Employment Type: Full-Time. 
 Position Overview We are seeking an M.Tech Hardware Electronic Design Engineer with strong first-principles circuit design ability, capable of taking a product from concept to validated hardware. This is a design origination role, not a schematic-copying or layout-only role . The candidate is expected to generate original electronic hardware architectures, substantiate them with independent design calculations and analysis, and carry them through schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, and qualification. The role spans two areas. The first is power electronic and embedded hardware, including power conversion stages, drive and control electronics, and digital and analog embedded boards for rectifiers, inverters, UPS, SMPS, and power converters. The second is sensor, control, and communication hardware for portable, handheld, and ruggedized products, requiring low-power design, robust interfacing, and electromagnetic and environmental hardening. Both industrial and ruggedized or defence-grade applications are covered. The candidate will work closely with mechanical, PCB fabrication, firmware, manufacturing, quality, and project teams. 
 Role & responsibilities Develop original hardware architectures and topologies for new products from customer specifications, functional requirements, and system-level constraints. Design analog, digital, mixed-signal, and power electronic circuits, including power supplies, DC-DC converters, drivers, protection circuits, sensor front ends, and microcontroller or FPGA/DSP-based embedded boards. Perform independent design calculations covering power budget, efficiency and losses, component derating, thermal dissipation, worst-case timing and tolerance analysis, signal and power integrity, EMI/EMC margins, and reliability (MTBF) Select and size power semiconductors, magnetics, filters, and heat-dissipating components, and coordinate with mechanical design on heat sinking, thermal interface, and cooling. Design hardware for shock, vibration, and transportation environments, including component mounting, conformal coating, and connector and cable selection for ruggedized equipment. Design sensor, control, and communication hardware for sealed portable and handheld products, meeting low-power and battery-operated constraints. repare schematics, PCB stack-up and layout guidelines, Bills of Materials, and interconnect and cable diagrams, and review PCB layouts for correctness, manufacturability, and EMI/EMC compliance. Ensure hardware design meets EMI/EMC, creepage and clearance, earthing and bonding, isolation, safety, and ingress-protection interface requirements in coordination with mechanical design. Interface with vendors and suppliers on component sourcing, PCB fabrication feasibility, and first-article inspection. Prepare design documentation, calculation sheets, design review records, test reports, and product release documentation. Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and contribute to design standardisation and product innovation. Work with mechanical, firmware, and software teams for product integration. 
 Preferred candidate profile Masters in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Power Electronics, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline (mandatory). 2 to 8 years of relevant experience in hardware/electronic product design, preferably for power electronic, embedded, electrical, or ruggedized equipment. Fresh M.Tech graduates with a strong design thesis/project background may also be considered. Demonstrated record of designing new hardware, not only modifying or debugging existing designs. Candidates should be prepared to discuss circuits they personally originated. Ability to carry out power, thermal, signal-integrity, and reliability calculations independently, and to defend the assumptions behind them in a design review. Strong command of schematic capture and PCB design tools (Altium Designer, OrCAD, Cadence Allegro, or KiCad), including multi-layer, high-speed, and mixed-signal layout. Hands-on circuit simulation capability (LTspice, PSpice, or equivalent) and familiarity with thermal simulation for electronic assemblies. Demonstrated experience delivering hardware qualified for EMI/EMC compliance, including filter design, shielding, grounding schemes, and resolution of emission or susceptibility failures found in testing. Working knowledge of power electronics fundamentals: switch-mode topologies, magnetics design, gate drive, and protection circuit design. Sound understanding of analog and digital electronics, embedded microcontroller/FPGA interfacing, communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, Ethernet), and basic firmware bring-up support. Proficiency with lab instrumentation: oscilloscopes, DMMs, power analysers, logic analysers, and spectrum/network analysers, for board bring-up and debug. Familiarity with applicable standards for electronic hardware and ruggedized equipment, such as IEC/EN 61000 series EMI/EMC, MIL-STD-461 electromagnetic compatibility, MIL-STD-810 environmental, and IPC-2221/IPC-A-610 PCB design and assembly standards, will be an added advantage. Strong analytical ability, ownership, communication skills, and willingness to work hands-on with prototypes and on the shop floor. Added Advantage The following are not essential requirements, but will be considered favourably: Exposure to the design of fuze electronics, safety and arming electronics, or other precision electro-mechanical armament sub-system hardware. Familiarity with fuze safety design criteria and qualification standards such as MIL-STD-1316, STANAG 4187, and MIL-STD-331, and with fuze safety review, certification, and clearance processes. Experience in precision, low-power sensor and trigger circuit design, including inertial sensing, timing circuits, and initiation/firing circuit hardware. Experience designing hardware that must survive severe launch, setback, spin, and impact environments, supported by explicit shock and vibration qualification. Experience designing for long-term storage without maintenance, including component derating for shelf life, battery/primary-cell interface design, and corrosion- and moisture-resistant hardening. Exposure to air gun, centrifuge, jolt, jumble, and drop testing of armament or precision electronic sub-systems. Experience preparing hazard analyses, FMEA, fault trees, and safety documentation for review by certification or safety authorities. 
 Interested candidates may apply with their updated rsum along with details of hardware/electronic designs they have personally originated, including the design calculations, analysis, and validation carried out for them. Candidates are encouraged to include examples of both power electronic/embedded board work and sensor, control, or communication hardware work where available.

title: Sr. PCB Design Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a PCB Design Engineer who turns schematics into manufacturable boards in Altium Designer - and takes pride in a layout that comes back from fabrication working the first time. You will lay out multilayer, high-speed and mixed-signal boards for embedded products across medical, industrial and IoT domains, and own the board s journey from library to Gerbers to assembled prototype. The person we are looking for sweats footprints and stack-ups, thinks about EMI and the enclosure before routing the first trace, and stays with the board through fabrication, assembly and bring-up rather than throwing Gerbers over the wall. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Schematic and Library Work Work with the development team on schematic design as per product requirements. Design and develop schematics in Altium Designer. Create and maintain component and footprint libraries for new components - correct the footprint once, not on three boards. PCB Layout Design PCB layouts in Altium considering EMI/EMC requirements, enclosure constraints, thermal behaviour and DFM/DFA. Route high-speed and impedance-controlled sections: memory interfaces, USB, Ethernet, differential pairs. Build 3D models to verify component placement and enclosure fitment before fabrication, not after. Generate clean fabrication outputs: Gerbers, drill files, assembly drawings, pick-and-place. Prototype Coordination Coordinate with PCB manufacturers on ordering, technical queries and delivery. Handle component procurement for prototypes, including alternates when parts are unavailable. Coordinate with the prototype assembly team and support the hardware team during bring-up of your boards. 
 
 Technical Skills Required 
 Altium Designer: Expertise in schematic and PCB design; multilayer and mixed-signal boards. High-Speed Layout: Multilayer high-speed design: impedance control, length matching, differential pairs, return paths. MCU-based Designs: Layout for 32-bit microcontroller-based designs and their supporting circuits. Memory Interfaces: Flash, eMMC, SDRAM, DDR2/DDR3/DDR4 - routing, termination and timing constraints. Interfaces: On-board (SPI, I2C) and external (USB, Ethernet) interface layout. Wireless: Layout for BLE, Wi-Fi, RF, LoRa sections: antenna keep-outs, matching networks, ground strategy. EMI / EMC: Layout practices for emissions and immunity; awareness of CE/FCC pre-compliance implications. Ways of Working: Comfortable in a fast-paced Agile / Scrum development environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills (Added Advantage) 
 Experience on medical device boards, or other regulated/compliance-driven products. Thermal analysis basics: copper pours, thermal vias, dissipation planning. Exposure to signal integrity tools or post-layout simulation. Experience in a product design services or contract development environment. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Engineering graduate in an Electronics-based branch or equivalent. 2 to 4 years of experience in PCB design. Good verbal and written communication in English. 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 Boards you lay out come back working, with rework the exception rather than the rule. Fabrication and assembly houses rarely need to call about your output package. Library parts you create are trusted and reused across projects. 
 
 Location 
 Pune, Wakad Office.

Identify potential suppliers and conduct techno-commercial evaluations. Float RFQs, obtain quotations, prepare cost comparisons, and support supplier selection. Conduct commercial negotiations to achieve competitive cost and business objectives. Support Purchase Order release and ensure timely availability of materials and components. Develop alternate sources to reduce supply risk and dependency on single suppliers. Support localization, import substitution, and cost reduction initiatives. 
 2. Vendor Development Identify and develop suppliers for Forgings, Precision Machining, Castings, Fabrication, and engineering components. Conduct supplier capability assessments covering technology, machinery, capacity, quality systems, manpower, and infrastructure. Support suppliers in developing manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, and inspection systems. Monitor supplier development plans and ensure achievement of project milestones. Develop suppliers from initial assessment through sample development and series production readiness. Drive supplier improvement in Quality, Cost, Delivery, Productivity, and Capacity. 
 3. Technical Knowledge Forging Knowledge of Hot Forging, Cold Forging, Closed Die Forging, and Open Die Forging. Understanding of raw material selection, billet preparation, heating, forging operations, trimming, and heat treatment. Knowledge of forging dies, tooling concepts, grain flow, metallurgical requirements, and mechanical properties. Understanding of forging defects, process capability, material yield, scrap reduction, and productivity improvement. Ability to evaluate forging supplier capability, capacity, manufacturing feasibility, and cost structure.

Understanding of machining process planning, cutting tools, fixtures, and work-holding concepts. Knowledge of cutting parameters including speed, feed, depth of cut, cycle time, and tool life. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, critical dimensions, tolerances, and surface finish requirements. Knowledge of CMM, gauges, inspection systems, machine capability, and process capability. Ability to assess machining capacity, productivity, cycle time, and manufacturing feasibility. 
 5. Costing & Cost Reduction Prepare and review should-cost models for Forging and Machining components. Understand raw material cost, material yield, scrap, machine hour rate, cycle time, tooling, labour, overhead, and logistics costs. Conduct cost benchmarking and support commercial negotiations. Drive cost reduction through VA/VE, VAVE, localization, alternate sourcing, and productivity improvement. Monitor and report cost savings and cost avoidance projects. 
 6. New Product & Supplier Development Participate in new product development from RFQ and feasibility stage. Coordinate with Engineering and suppliers for manufacturing feasibility and process development. Monitor sample development and project timelines. Support APQP and PPAP activities. Ensure smooth transition from development to series production. Escalate critical technical, quality, capacity, and timeline risks. 
 7. Supplier Quality & Performance Management Monitor supplier performance related to Quality, Cost, Delivery, Development, and Responsiveness. Participate in supplier audits and improvement programs. Support continuous improvement and Zero Defect initiatives.

description:
About the Role 
We are looking for a highly creative, multi-talented Videographer & Editor to join our team. In
this role, you will own the entire video production process from concept to final delivery. You
aren't just someone who knows how to operate a camera; you are a visual storyteller and a

Strong Portfolio: A compelling showreel or portfolio demonstrating expertise in shooting, editing, and motion graphics is mandatory Trend & Marketing Awareness: A strong understanding of current social media algorithms and a proven ability to translate internet trends into product-focused marketing videos. Visual Storytelling: A strong understanding of narrative structure, pacing, color grading, and composition. Problem-Solving: Ability to think on your feet during shoots and find creative workarounds in the editing room. Time Management: Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. Technical Proficiency 
 Camera & Gear: Hands-on experience with professional cinema or mirrorless/DSLR cameras, lighting setups, and external audio equipment. title: Laboratory Manager, Rubber
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: LABORATORY MANAGER Company: Stacwell Rubber Pvt. Ltd.
Location: KesnandWagholi, Pune, Maharashtra
Industry: Rubber Components Manufacturing – Aerospace, Defence, Navy, Railway, Oil & Gas, Nuclear, Healthcare, Food & Drinking Water, Chemical, and Renewable Energy
Department: Laboratory / R&D / Quality Assurance
Position: Laboratory Manager
Reports To: Plant Head / General Manager
Functional Coordination With: Quality Manager / Production Manager / Commercial Manager / Purchase Manager 1. JOB SUMMARY The laboratory manager will be responsible for leading the laboratory, rubber formulation, material testing, product qualification, and technical validation activities at Stacwell Rubber Pvt. Ltd. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Rubber Formulation & Compound Development Design, develop, and optimize rubber formulations based on customer requirements and application conditions. Develop new rubber compounds for aerospace, defense, railway, oil & gas, and other critical applications. Review customer specifications, drawings, technical requirements, and applicable standards before formulation development. Select appropriate polymers, fillers, plasticizers, curing systems, additives, and other ingredients. Develop formulations considering hardness, tensile strength, elongation, compression set, temperature resistance, aging, chemical resistance, and other application requirements. Conduct laboratory trials and compound optimization. Coordinate with production for scale-up of laboratory formulations to production batches. Maintain formulation records, revision history, and technical documentation. Support cost optimization without compromising required product performance. B. Laboratory Management Manage day-to-day laboratory operations and testing activities. Plan and prioritize laboratory testing based on production schedules, customer requirements, and development activities. Supervise laboratory technicians and technical staff. Ensure proper operation, maintenance, and availability of laboratory equipment. Maintain laboratory discipline, 5S, and workflow efficiency. Establish and maintain laboratory testing procedures and work instructions. Ensure proper identification, handling, storage, and traceability of samples. Ensure compliance with laboratory safety requirements. C. Rubber Material & Product Testing Raw rubber materials Chemicals and ingredients Rubber compounds Semi-finished products Finished rubber components O-rings, seals, gaskets, and other critical rubber products D. Quality Assurance & Compliance ISO 9001 AS9100 ISO/IEC 17025 NADCAP laboratory/customer requirements, where applicable ASTM standards ISO standards SAE standards DIN standards Indian Standards Customer-specific specifications and test methods E. Calibration & Laboratory Equipment Control Prepare and maintain the laboratory calibration plan. Ensure timely calibration of all measuring and testing equipment. Maintain calibration certificates and records. Coordinate preventive maintenance and servicing of laboratory equipment. Verify equipment functionality before use. Identify equipment requiring repair, replacement, or external calibration. Ensure no expired or out-of-calibration equipment is used for product acceptance testing. F. Documentation & Technical Reporting Certificate of Analysis (COA) Test reports Material approval reports Validation reports Compound development reports Qualification reports Laboratory records Calibration records Customer technical reports Audit documentation Test method documentation Formulation records Trial and development reports Ensure complete traceability of raw materials, formulations, batches, samples, and test results. G. Research & Development Develop new rubber compounds based on customer/application requirements. Conduct laboratory trials and validation testing. Optimize existing formulations for performance, quality, and cost. Study material performance and identify improvement opportunities. Support new product development activities. Coordinate with Production and Quality during product/process trials. Support transfer of approved formulations from laboratory to production. Maintain technical knowledge of new rubber materials, additives, and technologies. H. Customer & Product Qualification Support Understand customer technical specifications and testing requirements. Coordinate customer-specific testing and qualification programs. Support product approval and qualification activities. Participate in technical discussions with customers when required. Support PPAP, FAI, and other customer documentation requirements. Prepare technical evidence for customer approvals. Ensure customer-specific test methods are correctly implemented. I. Team Management & Development Lead and supervise laboratory personnel. Allocate daily laboratory activities. Monitor employee performance and discipline. Train laboratory personnel on testing methods, equipment, and safety. Develop technical competency of laboratory staff. Conduct skill-gap analysis and arrange technical training. Ensure adequate manpower coverage for laboratory activities. 3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS Rubber formulation and compound design Natural and synthetic rubber systems Rubber chemicals and additives Vulcanization and curing systems Rubber mixing processes Open mill / two-roll mill operations Internal mixing process knowledge Rubber testing and characterization Product qualification and validation ASTM / ISO / SAE / DIN standards Aerospace rubber requirements Customer-specific specifications Calibration and laboratory management Root Cause Analysis CAPA FMEA SPC Problem-solving techniques Technical documentation and traceability 4. EDUCATIONAL Essential: B.E./B.Tech in any relevant discipline such as Rubber Technology / Rubber & Chemical Technology Polymer Engineering / Polymer Technology Chemical Engineering Mechanical Engineering 5. EXPERIENCE REQUIRED Assistant Lab Manager 5–8 years of relevant experience in: Rubber formulation Rubber testing Laboratory operations Compound development/product qualification Lab Manager 8–15 years of relevant experience in: Rubber formulation and design Rubber testing laboratory Compound development Product qualification and validation Technical customer support/laboratory/team management Candidates with strong experience in aerospace rubber, sealing products, and critical applications will be preferred. 6. PREFERRED INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE Experience in one or more of the following industries will be preferred: Aerospace rubber components Aviation sealing systems Defense rubber products Navy applications Railway rubber components Oil & gas sealing products Nuclear applications 7. AEROSPACE & CRITICAL INDUSTRY RESPONSIBILITIES For aerospace and other critical applications, the lab manager shall: Ensure compliance with applicable AS9100 requirements. Maintain complete material and product traceability. Support NADCAP and customer audit requirements where applicable. Maintain strict control of laboratory records and technical documentation. Ensure controlled handling of critical materials and samples. Support FAI and product qualification requirements. Ensure validation and qualification testing is completed as per approved specifications. Maintain appropriate revision control of customer specifications and test methods. Ensure contamination control and proper laboratory housekeeping. Support customer-specific requirements for aerospace and critical applications. 8. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Performance will be monitored through measurable indicators, including: Number of new rubber formulations developed. Number of formulations successfully qualified. First-time right laboratory testing. Laboratory test accuracy and reliability. On-time completion of testing and reports. Customer qualification success. Reduction in product rejection. Reduction in customer complaints. Calibration compliance. Laboratory audit compliance. Implementation of process/product improvements. Reduction in formulation development time. Successful transfer of laboratory formulations to production. Laboratory team skill development. Cost optimization through formulation improvement.

description:

title: Embedded Hardware Engineer
description:
EMBEDDED HARDWARE ENGINEER II 
 Who We Are Pinaak Aerial Systems Private Limited is a drone technology startup developing indigenous, mission-configurable UAV platforms for defence applications. We develop flight-control, communication, payload and supporting electronic systems for reliable operation in demanding field environments. 
 About the role As a Hardware Engineer II, you will independently own electronic hardware modules and subsystems for UAV flight controllers, payload systems, communication electronics, power systems and onboard electronicsfrom requirements and circuit design through PCB development, prototype bring-up, validation and production support. The role requires strong hands-on electronics design capability, independent debugging maturity and the ability to resolve complex hardware, power, signal-integrity and hardware–firmware integration issues with limited supervision. This remains a hands-on individual-contributor role. You may guide Engineer I team members on specific designs and debugging activities but will not own organisation-wide hardware architecture or final design authority. 
 Key Responsibilities Independently own hardware modules from requirements, architecture and component selection through schematic, PCB, validation and release. Design analog, digital, mixed-signal, power, communication and microcontroller-based circuits. Select components based on electrical performance, reliability, availability, lifecycle, cost and environmental requirements. Review and guide PCB placement and routing for power integrity, signal integrity, grounding, EMI/EMC, thermal performance and manufacturability. Design interfaces for microcontrollers, sensors, IMUs, GNSS, telemetry/RF modules, storage, ESCs, actuators and payload electronics. Design and validate DC-DC converters, LDOs, power sequencing, protection, battery interfaces and power-distribution circuits. Design and debug UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, ADC, PWM and other high-/low-speed interfaces. Independently perform prototype board bring-up and hardware–firmware integration. Diagnose intermittent and complex hardware failures using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, multimeters, current probes and other laboratory equipment. Analyse signal quality, power rails, current consumption, startup behaviour, reset conditions, timing and noise-related issues. Conduct design reviews, schematic reviews and PCB reviews for assigned subsystems. Perform component derating, tolerance analysis and basic worst-case design assessment where required. Support EMI/EMC, temperature, vibration, environmental and reliability testing and resolve failures. Analyse field and flight failures, establish root causes and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence. Work with PCB fabrication, assembly and manufacturing teams to resolve prototype and production issues. Assess hardware release readiness based on functional validation, environmental testing, known issues and production readiness. Maintain schematics, BOMs, PCB revision records, design calculations, validation reports and engineering-change documentation. Guide junior engineers on specific circuit-design, testing and debugging activities. 
 Technology Exposure Circuit Design: Analog, digital, mixed-signal, MCU-based systems, power supplies, protection, signal conditioning and sensor interfaces. Interfaces: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, USB, ADC, PWM, GPIO and board-level communication interfaces. PCB Development: Schematic capture, multilayer PCB design, grounding, impedance considerations, power/signal integrity, DFM/DFT and PCB bring-up. UAV Electronics: Flight controllers, IMUs, GNSS, telemetry/RF modules, ESC interfaces, payload electronics, power distribution and onboard communication systems. Tools: Altium Designer/KiCad/OrCAD or equivalent; oscilloscopes, logic analysers, multimeters, electronic loads, laboratory power supplies and relevant simulation/analysis tools. 
 Required Skills Strong practical knowledge of analog and digital circuit design. Hands-on experience independently designing electronic products or substantial PCB modules. Strong understanding of microcontroller hardware, sensors, communication interfaces and power supplies. Good understanding of schematic design and multilayer PCB design practices. Practical knowledge of grounding, decoupling, EMI/EMC, signal integrity and power integrity. Ability to perform component selection and interpret datasheets beyond reference-design copying. Strong board bring-up and hardware-debugging capability. Ability to independently diagnose complex or intermittent hardware and hardware–firmware integration failures. Understanding of DFM, DFT, component lifecycle and production considerations. Ability to plan validation, assess design risks and determine release readiness for assigned hardware. Strong problem-solving ability, attention to detail and engineering judgement. Clear technical documentation and cross-functional communication skills. 
 Preferred Profile B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, Electrical, Instrumentation, Avionics or equivalent. 3–5 years of relevant hardware design and product-development experience. Demonstrated ownership of at least one electronic product or substantial PCB/module from design through validation. Hands-on experience with Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD or equivalent. Experience with MCU-based hardware, sensors, CAN, GNSS, RF/telemetry or power electronics. Experience in UAV, aerospace, robotics, automotive, industrial electronics or other reliability-critical electronic products will be preferred. Exposure to EMI/EMC testing, environmental qualification and production transfer will be advantageous. 
 What We Value We value engineers who can independently convert system requirements into reliable electronic hardware and pursue failures until the actual root cause is established. The role requires more than schematic capture. It requires sound circuit-design fundamentals, careful component selection, PCB judgement, structured validation and understanding of how hardware behaves in real products and field conditions. title: Service Desk Quality Analyst
description:
OVERVIEW 
The Service Desk Quality Analyst supports the Service Desk operation by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and quality of ticket handling and documentation. While this role primarily operates behind the scenes, it may occasionally involve handling service tickets to support operational needs or gain deeper insight into service patterns. Key responsibilities include reviewing ticket coding for accuracy, interpreting dashboards, identifying recurring issues, and converting data into actionable insights for service leads. Tasks involve auditing tickets, flagging miscategorized entries, reporting on Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, monitoring backlog trends, and assisting problem management through thorough data analysis. Acting as an extension of the quality function, this role plays a critical part in enhancing ticket hygiene, improving team performance, and delivering operational insights that drive continuous service desk improvements.
 DESCRIPTION The Service Desk Quality Analyst is a mid-level role that works closely with the Service Desk team and leadership to: Monitor incoming new tickets in the Service Desk system to ensure timely and accurate assignment to the appropriate team members Monitor incoming escalations to promptly identify high-priority or complex issues requiring immediate attention from Senior Analysts or Service Desk management Maintain real-time oversight of ticket queues and escalation paths to prevent bottlenecks and service delays Provide backup support to Service Desk Analysts by handling tickets as needed during peak periods, absences, or resource shortages, helping maintain consistent service levels Review and audit service desk tickets for coding accuracy and categorization Identify and flag misclassified or incomplete entries Monitor SLA compliance and generate weekly/monthly performance reports Analyze incident and request trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation or documentation improvements Track backlog trends and report on resolution times Provide support in problem management by conducting comprehensive, data-driven root cause analysis Interpret dashboards and translate technical data into clear, actionable insights for service improvement Contribute to quality improvement initiatives by highlighting gaps and supporting process documentation Use dashboards (e.g., Zoho ManageEngine, ServiceNow, Jira) to extract performance insights Assist with the standardization of ticket documentation practices Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure consistency in incident reporting and documentation Full-time role with rotational shifts based on business requirements Collaborate with Service Desk leads and quality teams to translate data insights into actionable recommendations Assist in documenting known issues, process updates, and best practices to support continuous improvement initiatives Participate in team meetings and quality reviews, sharing insights that help drive service enhancements Track and analyze the volume and types of escalations to identify training needs for Service Desk staff Complete all other tasks deemed appropriate for the role and assigned by the manager/supervisor. 
 REQUIRED SKILLS Process Documentation skills Advanced Excel skills Ability to deep dive into numbers and draw conclusions Understanding of Root Cause Analysis Strong reasoning and analytical skills Time Management and prioritization Multi-tasking capabilities Ability to manage several priorities at once Ability to focus for long periods of time to determine a solution Strong communication skills (both written and verbal) Organize thoughts and communicate verbal messages appropriately to listeners and situations Demonstrated proficiency in grammar and typing skills Comfortable with repetitive tasks Good attention to detail and willingness to learn Ability to work independently Willingness to cooperate with others and work for the greater good. 
 REQUIRED EXPEREINCE & QUALIFICATIONS A year of phone, email, or chat support experience in IT Service Desk, Helpdesk, Technical Support, or US customer support experience Two years of data analysis and reporting or a Bachelors degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field Familiar with ITIL and its processes, specifically those related to Service Request, Incident, Change, and Problem Management Knowledge of Customer Service principles and practices Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., Zoho Manage Engine, ServiceNow, Jira) Understanding of SLA metrics Experience in process documentation

title: Sourcing Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Sourcing Manager Position Summary The Sourcing Manager with 10-13 years of experience responsible for developing and implementing strategic sourcing initiatives to meet the company's procurement requirements while optimizing costs, ensuring quality, and maintaining a reliable supply chain. The role involves supplier management, contract negotiations, cost analysis, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement of sourcing processes. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Develop and implement sourcing strategies to meet organizational procurement needs while optimizing costs and maintaining quality standards. Manage the company's supply portfolio and ensure transparency of spending. Generate and implement efficient sourcing and category management strategies. Optimize sourcing procedures to achieve maximum efficiency and effectiveness. Analyze procurement costs and identify opportunities to reduce expenditure. Perform cost analysis, scenario analysis, and benchmarking activities. Supplier Management Evaluate and develop new suppliers. Visit production facilities and do capability checks where needed. Build sourcing strategies for our key fastener categories, balancing cost, quality, and supply security. Lead price negotiations and frame agreements with key suppliers, securing good payment terms and MOQs. Track suppliers performance (on-time delivery, quality, cost, responsiveness). Reduce supply risk by developing multiple sourcing channels, and keep an eye on raw material prices and logistics risks that could affect supply. Sales Support Work with Sales on customer bids, provide fast, accurate sourcing quotes and alert any delivery or feasibility risks. Use your supplier relationships and market knowledge to help Sales put together competitive bids that protect our margin. Purchasing Operations Work with suppliers on pricing, lead times, MOQs, and delivery schedules. Keep an eye on stock levels and work with Sales and Warehouse to balance having enough inventory without overstocking. Handle quality and delivery problems as they come upbe the first-person to suppliers call when something goes wrong, and make sure issues get fixed properly. Sustainability & Compliance Promote sustainability initiatives and actively communicate the company's sustainable value proposition to suppliers. Train and guide suppliers on our sustainability requirements. Help suppliers understand Bufab requirements and support suppliers gradually meet our standards over time. Check supplier practices against our sustainability checklist during visits and audits. Track their progress and follow up on gaps. Health, Safety & Quality Maintain awareness of and comply with Occupational Health & Safety requirements in accordance with ISO 45001 standards. Actively participate in workplace health and safety programs, including training, audits, and documentation activities. 
 Preferred candidate profile Education & Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Background in Trading Environment/Fastener or General Hardware Multi Variety components would be an added advantage 815 years of relevant sourcing, procurement, or supply chain experience, preferably in a multinational organization. Strong command of written and spoken English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and ERP systems. Skills & Competencies Strong negotiation and contract management skills. Proficiency in procurement tools, ERP systems, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Solid understanding of procurement and supply chain management principles. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational and decision-making capabilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.

description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP HANA SCM PLM, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and configuring SAP S/4HANA\-based Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions for clients. Your expertise in SAP S/4HANA based PLM applications will enable you to help clients optimize their product development, manufacturing, and supply chain operations.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Design and Implement Solutions: Design and implement SAP S/4HANA PLM solutions to meet client business requirements, utilizing your knowledge of SAP S/4HANA based PLM applications to optimize product development, manufacturing, and supply chain operations.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their business requirements, identify opportunities for improvement, and design solutions that meet their needs.
* Configure SAP S/4HANA PLM: Configure SAP S/4HANA PLM applications to support client business processes, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery.
* Deliver Client Solutions: Deliver high\-quality solutions that meet client expectations, leveraging your expertise in SAP S/4HANA based PLM applications to drive business value.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Exposure to SAP S/4HANA: Experience working with SAP S/4HANA based PLM applications, with knowledge of their capabilities and functionality to optimize product development, manufacturing, and supply chain operations.
* Understanding of PLM Solutions: Familiarity with designing and implementing Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions, including configuration and integration with existing systems.
* Client Requirements Analysis: Exposure to working with clients to understand their business requirements, identifying opportunities for improvement, and designing solutions to meet their needs.
* SAP S/4HANA Configuration: Experience with configuring SAP S/4HANA PLM applications to support business processes and ensure seamless integration.
* Solution Delivery: Exposure to delivering high\-quality solutions that meet client expectations, leveraging expertise in SAP S/4HANA based PLM applications to drive business value.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* SAP S/4HANA Implementation: Exposure to implementing SAP S/4HANA\-based Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions, with knowledge of their capabilities and functionality to optimize product development, manufacturing, and supply chain operations.
* PLM Solution Design: Familiarity with designing Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions, including configuration and integration with existing systems to meet client business requirements.
* SAP S/4HANA Configuration: Experience with configuring SAP S/4HANA PLM applications to support business processes and ensure seamless integration.

description:
JD for Agentic AI Lead Digital Engineering Opportunity in Modern Technology Platforms Step into the Digital Engineering Studio, where bold ideas, data, and intelligent automation come together to redefine the future of insurance. This is a high-energy environment for young technologists who are eager to learn, build, and innovate at scale. You ll work across project governance, UI/UX engineering, API development, and modern web and mobile platforms, creating intuitive portals for self-buying health insurance, policy renewal, and claims tracking. Every solution you build-whether customer-facing or agent-enabled-will have real-world impact, shaping seamless digital journeys for millions. For aspiring Data Engineers and AI enthusiasts, this role adds an exciting edge. You ll design and power data pipelines that fuel RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions, enable intelligent search, and support AI-driven decisioning across Insurance Digital platforms. With access to AI-powered coding assistants and agentic development tools, you ll accelerate development while learning best-in-class engineering practices. From leading Core Policy Admin System integrations to connecting with government ecosystems like ONDC, PMBY, and SARTHI, you ll gain hands-on exposure to large-scale, mission-critical systems-perfect for those who want to grow fast, experiment fearlessly, and build the digital backbone of tomorrow s insurance landscape. We are seeking an Agentic AI Lead with strong hands-on and strategic expertise in architecting and delivering intelligent, autonomous, and AI-enabled applications at enterprise scale, leveraging modern agentic and GenAI frameworks, cloud-native platforms, and scalable backend architectures. The role requires deep experience leading the design and development of robust backend and platform services, integrating enterprise APIs and diverse data sources, working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and deploying production-grade systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using mature CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate is a customer- and business-centric technology leader who can translate complex requirements into secure, resilient, and high-quality agentic solutions supporting web, mobile, and enterprise workflows, while setting architectural direction, enforcing engineering excellence, and guiding teams on advanced agent orchestration patterns, DevOps/MLOps best practices, and reliable delivery of impactful AI-driven digital solutions. Candidate should have experience of Leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, code reviews, debugging assistants) to improve coding speed, quality, and developer productivity. Demonstrate openness to adopting AI-based tools and workflows to accelerate development while adhering to coding standards and best practices. Understanding of the general insurance domain is good to have. Location: Pune - Work from Office Notice Period: Up to 2 Months. Agentic AI Lead - 8+ Years Roles & Responsibilities Provide enterprise-wide technical and strategic leadership for the vision, architecture, and execution of large-scale agentic AI platforms and solutions across multiple business lines and domains. Own the agentic AI technology roadmap , guiding long-term evolution of agent architectures, platforms, accelerators, and operating models aligned with business and industry strategy. Lead the design and governance of complex, distributed agentic systems , including multi-agent ecosystems, cross-domain orchestration, long-running autonomous workflows, and human-in-the-loop decision systems. Set architectural guardrails and engineering standards for agent design, orchestration, memory, state management, reasoning, planning, and failure recovery at enterprise scale. Act as the highest level of technical authority on agent behaviour and intelligence, taking oversight and accountability for reasoning strategies, planning algorithms, escalation logic, risk handling, and system trustworthiness. Architect highly composable AI systems that integrate LLMs, traditional ML models, enterprise tools, APIs, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native services into cohesive intelligent workflows. Drive large-scale enterprise integration , enabling agentic platforms to work seamlessly with legacy systems, core business applications, data ecosystems, and partner platforms. Define and institutionalize enterprise reference architectures , design patterns, reusable IP, accelerators, and engineering playbooks for agentic AI adoption. Champion Responsible AI at an enterprise level , embedding governance, explainability, risk controls, auditability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance across platforms and solutions. Partner with executive stakeholders, business leaders, and enterprise architects to shape AI-driven business transformation, translating strategic objectives into scalable agentic capabilities. Oversee system performance and economics , driving optimization across quality, accuracy, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost at portfolio scale. Provide executive oversight for production operations , including incident management, systemic risk mitigation, platform resilience, and SLA adherence across mission-critical deployments. Build and lead high-performing agentic engineering teams , mentoring senior technologists, principal engineers, and architects, and setting a culture of technical excellence and innovation. Drive innovation, thought leadership, and external visibility , contributing to internal IP, accelerators, whitepapers, patents, conferences, and client-facing AI transformation initiatives. Education BE / B.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline Postgraduate qualification (M.Tech / MS / MBA - preferred) Required Experience & Technical Skills 14-18 years of overall experience in advanced software engineering and AI systems, including leading AI, GenAI, or autonomous agent initiatives at enterprise scale . Proven track record in architecting and scaling agentic AI platforms across multiple domains, teams, and geographies. Deep expertise in multi-agent systems , autonomous decision-making, planning and reasoning architectures, human-agent collaboration, and enterprise workflow automation. Advanced hands-on and conceptual mastery of LLMs , prompt/program synthesis strategies, reasoning frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and continuous learning loops. Strong experience with agent frameworks and platforms (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.) with the ability to design custom enterprise-grade agent foundations beyond framework defaults. Expert-level understanding of agent orchestration , including hierarchical/task-based planning, tool invocation strategies, exception handling, resilience patterns, and agent collaboration protocols without over-dependence on LangChain/LangGraph-style abstractions. Deep knowledge of memory, state, and context management , including short-term/long-term memory, vector databases, knowledge graphs, session isolation, and lifecycle governance. Advanced experience with RAG systems , search relevance optimization, grounding strategies, hallucination mitigation, and enterprise knowledge integration. Demonstrated algorithmic and model stewardship , including evaluation frameworks, risk modelling, bias analysis, and continuous optimization. Extensive experience deploying and operating AI platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud-native architectures. Experience working with Postgre database. Strong leadership in MLOps and AI Platform Engineering , including CI/CD, model and prompt lifecycle management, testing at scale, and controlled enterprise releases. Expertise in AI observability and governance , including telemetry, tracing, quality evaluation frameworks, explainability dashboards, and cost governance. Strong command of AI security, privacy, and regulatory compliance , aligning with enterprise policies, industry regulations, and Responsible AI standards. Preferred: Deep exposure to General Insurance (Health, Motor, Travel) or other regulated industries, with experience driving AI-led transformation of core business processes. Leadership & Behavioural Competencies: Demonstrates strategic thinking, executive presence, and systems-level problem solving in highly complex environments. Communicates with clarity and influence at senior leadership and C-suite levels, bridging business strategy and deep technology. Inspires and develops senior technical leaders, fostering innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence at scale. Exhibits strong professional integrity, decisiveness, and resilience in high-stakes, mission-critical AI initiatives.

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
Position: School Admission Counsellor
 Department: Admissions / Administration
 Experience: 1-3 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: NIBM Road, Kondhwa, Pune
 Reporting To: Admission Head & Principal 
 Position Overview 
 We are looking for a professional, confident, and parent-friendly Admission Officer who will be responsible for managing the end-to-end admission enquiry process along with front office operations . The candidate will serve as the first point of contact for prospective parents, students, visitors, and other stakeholders , creating a warm and professional impression of the school. The role will involve handling admission enquiries, counselling parents, conducting follow-ups, coordinating school visits, maintaining admission records, and supporting the smooth functioning of the front office. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Admissions & Parent Counselling Handle admission enquiries received through walk-ins, telephone calls, emails, WhatsApp and online platforms . Understand parents' requirements and provide accurate information about the school's curriculum, academic programmes, facilities, fee structure, activities, and admission process . Counsel prospective parents and students and address their queries professionally. Conduct and coordinate school/campus tours for prospective parents. Explain the complete admission process, eligibility criteria, documentation requirements and timelines. Follow up with prospective parents regularly and support enquiry-to-admission conversion . Coordinate appointments and interactions with the Principal, Coordinators, or relevant academic team members. Assist parents with admission forms, document submission, assessments and other admission formalities. Ensure a smooth and positive parent experience throughout the admission journey. 
 2. Lead Management & Follow-up Maintain an updated database of all admission enquiries and leads. Record and track enquiries, follow-ups, visits, applications and admissions . Ensure timely follow-up with prospective parents and maintain proper communication records. Monitor pending enquiries and ensure that no prospective lead is missed. Prepare daily/weekly admission reports and share updates with the reporting manager. Work towards achieving assigned admission/enquiry conversion targets. 
 3. Front Office Operations Act as the first point of contact for parents, students, visitors and guests. Welcome and assist visitors in a warm, courteous and professional manner. Handle incoming and outgoing calls and direct them to the appropriate department/person. Handle general parent/visitor queries and ensure appropriate resolution or escalation. Maintain front office records, registers and other administrative documents. Coordinate with Administration, Academics, Transport, Accounts and other departments as required. 
 4. School Events & Admission Activities Support and coordinate Open Houses, Parent Orientation, Admission Events and School Tours . Assist in admission campaigns and other school promotional activities. Support the school during peak admission periods, events and parent interaction days. Represent the school professionally while interacting with prospective families. 
 5. Documentation & MIS Ensure accurate maintenance of admission forms and supporting documents. Update admission data in the school's ERP/CRM/Admission Management System . Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of student and parent information. Prepare admission-related MIS and reports as required by management. Maintain proper records of admission status, pending documents and follow-ups. 
 Candidate Profile 
 Education: Graduate in any discipline. Additional qualification in Management, Education, Administration or Customer Relationship Management will be an advantage. 
 Experience: 1-3 years of experience in School Admissions, Front Office, Counselling, Customer Service, Education Sales or a similar role. Prior experience in a school/educational institution will be preferred. 
 Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills , particularly in English. Strong interpersonal and parent-handling skills. Good counselling and convincing abilities. Pleasant, confident and professional personality. Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills. Good organizational and multitasking abilities. Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Google Workspace and/or CRM/ERP systems . Ability to work under pressure, particularly during the admission season. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. Presentable and professional in appearance and conduct. 
 Key Competencies 
 Parent Relationship Management | Admission Counselling | Lead Conversion | Follow-up | Front Office Management | Communication | Customer Service | MIS & Reporting | Coordination | Multitasking 
 Performance Indicators / KRAs Number of admission enquiries handled. Enquiry-to-visit conversion. Visit-to-admission conversion. Timely follow-up of leads. Accuracy of admission records and documentation. Parent satisfaction and service quality. Efficient management of front office operations. Timely submission of admission reports and MIS. 
 Preferred Candidate 
 The ideal candidate should be warm, articulate, target-oriented, organized and confident in interacting with parents . The person should be capable of balancing admission responsibilities with day-to-day front office duties while maintaining a professional image of the school.

description:
